steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Gyuh! That... That reaper's whirlwind... And that hairclip... Y-you're Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: The one and only!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Damn it. Just our luck, running into you.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: But don't get ahead of yourself, Gavial! Not even you could shake our faith in thick tails!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, you're such hot shit! Keep running!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, let's move. I can sort them out the next time I see them.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, how come you let them go?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You used to chase down every last person in a fight and beat them until they saw stars.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah. I used to do that.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But nah, now I just think they're kind of cute. Right, Doctor?

options: No idea what you're saying, but I agree.
Cuter than you breaking them in half.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Might sound strange coming from me, but this place is full of nothing but boneheads.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ah, whatever. Have to think all the goddamn time outside. I almost miss it here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Doctor, don't tell me you're a thick tail lover?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: 'Cause we're not gonna see eye-to-eye on that!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah! Well, thinking they're cute won't stop me beating the tar outta them.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: They're not... uh... what's the word...? Mutually exclusive!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial... you really have changed.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Mm? Hold on, Tomimi, you little brat.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I go away for a couple years and I come back to find your tail's even fatter.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wh-wh-whuh?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Gonna try and tell me you're with thick tails, too?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: No no no no! It's not like I wanted it to grow so thick!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: *Whimper* I want a nice, thin tail just like Gavial's...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, shucks. *Clicks tongue* What a poor kid you are.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Though watching you fight back there, your Arts are pretty strong now, huh?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: R... Really?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah. Come over to Rhodes Island and be an operator. Should be no problem for you.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ope... rator?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Operators are, uh... Well, I guess it's a job. Like me, I'm a Medic Operator.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I remember you were still learning from the shamans when I left, right?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yep! I've been disciplining myself every day for you, Gavial, so one day you'd come back!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: For me?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh... um, by that, I mean, for when you come back so I could help you out! Like I did just now!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, damn. You really did help out, then. Well done.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Eheheh... I love when you compliment me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Cool. Let's keep moving then. Do I remember the Temple's just ahead?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Eunectes has to be the Great Chief, c'mon. Look at how strong the whole tribe is.

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Yeah, and she's top of the pile. Everyone said if not Gavial, then Eunectes, and now Gavial's gone...

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Hey, over there!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: No way... Gavial?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Hey, Gavial! You're finally back!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Whoa! Long time no see, huh!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Hey, that feather on your waist is nice! Where'd it come from?

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Traded one of my weapons to Inam for it.

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Man, your tribe really has it good. Inam can get her hands on anything. I wish I could be with you guys too.

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Too bad. Inam hates crowds. But if there's anything you guys want, you can go through me!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Deal! ...Hey. Look over there.

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Is that... wait, it's Gavial!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: She's actually back?!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Gavial! So you weren't dead!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alive and well, baby!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Brother, come on. Stop trying to make a show. You've got the Stone Disease and all. Just go back home and lie down, okay?

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Who cares! What's a little disease in the face of the ceremony?!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: A little disease is still disease! And think about how bad it'd be for us if you went out there and showed everyone the rocks growing on your tail!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Look, Gavial might be gone, but now Zumama's sure to be the next Great Chief!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: That's the part I care about! I need to witness the moment Zumama becomes Chief!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Damnit, I should have listened to Zumama... huh? Brother, look over there!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: It couldn't be. Is that... Gavial?!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Has she come back to become Great Chief?

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: ...I'm sorry, but now I HAVE to see the ceremony.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Yeah. I don't think anyone can miss this now.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh? Those two look like they're from the Eunectes tribe...

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: It really is Gavial! You're finally back!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: I always believed in you, Gavial!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Hey, everyone, look! It's Gavial!

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: Gavial! Gavial! Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Whew, what a rowdy bunch... Looks like we oughta pick up the pace.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Mm-hm! Everyone loves the ceremony, after all. And everyone loves Gavial too!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh. Gavial, look at that sign there.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Lemme see. Tch, goddamned scratchy handwriting... Oh, look at that. It says 'Mahuizzotia.'

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Wait. What gives with the music?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And for that matter, why do I recognize it...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Wait! Doctor, this is an AUS song, isn't it?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, damn.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm not totally sure myself, but I've definitely heard people playing this before.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Snap out of it, Doctor! Don't just walk in!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Lots of AUS fans at Rhodes Island. That's gotta be it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ah. Yep, this is an AUS song.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: How do you know what AUS is?!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Around this time last year, a bunch of strange people calling themselves AUS came here from the outside.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: They held a concert at Inam's tribe first. After that, a whole lot of Tiacauh started treating them like heralds of the Mahuizzotia.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Later on, they were asked to stay for a long performance in the Temple surroundings.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I got to hear them once. Their music really was powerful, and beautiful... you could feel their awesome Arts, too.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ever since, lots of Tiacauh fell in love with this kind of music.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: And then suddenly one day, they disappeared. Everyone said they'd gone back to their ancestors' embrace.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But I knew they'd only left, same as Gavial had.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: The music playing right now should be coming from those 'speaker' things they left here. I think they also left behind some of their albums?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Speakers?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yep. They need Arts to function, so only priests and shamans can actually use them, and most of them are in Inam's tribe.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hahaha! Now that's a band of freewheelers.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Can't deny, their songs really get up in there. I haven't even stepped in and they've got my blood running hot. I think I'm beginning to like them!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Let's go, Doctor! We're gonna hear some music and enjoy a hell of a show!
